claims.statement: Customer-side capital commitment (Gold Circuit Electronics material announcement, 2026-10-07): its Suzhou subsidiary acquired one batch of operating machinery worth RMB 117,600,000 (about NT$558.4 million) from Kunshan Dongwei Technology, an unrelated party, chosen by price comparison and negotiation and approved by the board. The equipment type is not disclosed in the announcement.
